spec.candidate_spec: Location value given shape: the prediction of a model on shape, count, batter side and location, minus the prediction of the same model without location, averaged over a pitcher's pitches. Chosen on development folds that never read 2026 (baseball/pitch_quality/output/development_location.json: outcomes 2024 and 2025; r with next-season RV/100 +0.147, 90% interval +0.077 to +0.210, against +0.030 for the published features). train.py is unchanged until this test passes; the report is written as 3.0.0 and does not validate the published version.
spec.candidate_training: 4.0.0 (registered 2026-11-24, LOC-STABLE): the same grade with both models trained at learning rate 0.005 in bags of 20 (3.0.x: 0.03, bags of 10), so that it moves less between training seeds. Chosen on development folds that never read 2026 (baseball/pitch_quality/output/development_location_stability.json, outcomes 2024 and 2025, two seeds, run on GitHub's runners): mean movement between seeds 0.29 Location+ points with 2% of pitchers over 1, against 0.70 and 24% for the 3.0.x training; r with next-season RV/100 0.139 against 0.140. The gate statistic on those folds at seed 7: edge over the location-only features +0.071 (90% interval +0.011 to +0.126) and +0.147 (+0.091 to +0.204), passing the strict gate on both. Against the 3.0.x training on the same pitchers the edge was -0.011 (-0.020 to -0.003) on one fold and +0.006 (-0.001 to +0.013) on the other: no consistent difference, and smaller than the 3.0.x training's own spread between seeds (r 0.131 to 0.143 on the first fold). train.py is unchanged until this test passes; the report is written as 4.0.0 and does not validate the published version.
spec.target: Next-season run value per 100 pitches (RV/100), MLB pitchers with 500+ pitches in both seasons
spec.decision_dates: season start (March 1 of the outcome season)
spec.group_by: none: a pitch-level model; pitcher identity is not a feature
spec.gate_decided: Matt, 2026-11-19: strict (the 90% interval of the edge must exclude zero), measured against the published Location+ features trained on the same fold. The partial correlation with next-season RV/100 given Stuff+ is reported with its interval and is not part of the gate. Chosen with the development folds in view (baseball/pitch_quality/output/development_location_gates.json): a gain in r over Stuff+ alone could not pass at this sample size (about +0.015 on a partial r of 0.10). Stuff+ and last season's results are reported baselines.
spec.reproduction: Exact on the same machine; across machines tolerance ±0.01 in r (Matt, 2026-11-13). Official runs happen in CI.

vault.note: No sealed season yet: the only test season is 2026. The 2027 season becomes the vault when it completes.

spec.amended:
2026-11-23: the `candidate: 3.0.0` line is removed. 3.0.0 passed this block and was promoted on Nov 20, so the block now tests the published version; nothing else in it changed. (3.0.1 is the same model, stored instead of refit.) `candidate_spec` stays as the record of how the spec was chosen.
2026-11-24 (Matt chose the candidate): `candidate: 4.0.0` and `candidate_training` are added, and the module now trains both models at learning rate 0.005 in bags of 20. The target, fold, sample, gate and its baseline are unchanged: the candidate must beat the location-only features (`published_location`, the features of Location+ 2.0.0) with the edge's 90% interval above zero. One reported baseline is added, `v3_setup`: the same grade trained as 3.0.x trains it, on the same fold. It is the direct comparison and is not part of the gate: the change is made for seed stability, which this test does not measure (stability.py does, after the change), and on the development folds the two trainings' r differed by less than the seed spread. The 2026 outcomes have been read once already, by 3.0.0's test of this block (r 0.157). This is a second registered test on that season; the candidate and its training were chosen without it.
